readout_other: von Frey 50% mechanical withdrawal threshold; c-fos, MAP2, GAP43, tau by western blot and immunofluorescence; H&E and Fluoro-Jade C
direction_notes: LIFU increased c-fos-positive cells in the ACC of normal mice, raised the mechanical withdrawal threshold in CCI mice and reduced MAP2, GAP43 and tau expression.
safety_notes: H&E and Fluoro-Jade C staining showed no bleeding, necrosis or neuronal degeneration after LIFU.

timing.protocol_description: LIFU administered for 15 min/day for 21 days starting on day 91 after CCI surgery, under isoflurane anaesthesia, with a collimator placed over the ACC.

source_quotes.n_subjects: we randomly allocated normal C57BL/6J mice to a LIFU(-) group and a LIFU(+) group (n = 6 mice/group). For the LIFU neuromodulation experiment, 30 healthy male mice were randomly divided into the following three groups: the sham, CCI, and CCI+LIFU groups (n = 10 mice/group).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: For LIFU stimulation, we used a focused transducer (4 MHz), with an acoustic intensity of 0.95 MPa, a duty cycle (DC) of 10%, and a pulse repetition frequency (PRF) of 1.5 kHz [25].
